# Would a spend cap have stopped your runaway LLM bill?

> Stop a runaway OpenAI or Anthropic bill before it happens: hard per-user, per-feature and per-run dollar caps, an output-token ceiling, and circuit breakers that trip on agent loops. Free, open source, self-hosted proxy or a zero-dependency library.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
